draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.38, the 31st-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 5th of 34 at WR. He went 25th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Robert Woods. Testing standouts: vertical jump (89th percentile). College production: 1,192 receiving yards in 2019, 9th of 34 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 69 career games and 67 starts over 5 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 3 AV in 2024 against a career-best 15 in 2023. Weak spots: drop rate 8.5% (10th percentile), catch rate 53.2% (14th percentile). Played 7 of 17 games in 2024. Versus the typical Year-5 wide receiver who played: 374 receiving yards against a median of 255, above the norm.
